name: TravelPolicyComplianceAuditor
tagline: Audit every air, hotel, rail and car booking against policy – and chase the lost savings.
description: A complete corporate travel policy compliance app for Power Apps and Power Pages: policy rules for advance booking, lowest logical fare, cabin by flight time, hotel city caps, car caps and preferred suppliers; an audit workflow from flag to reason, manager review, exception or breach; lost-savings dashboards and traveller/manager follow-up digests.
features: Lost savings vs lowest logical fare and caps
Reason codes and manager approval limit
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control, shared src/app)
